title: Bloom Project Document 1.31
$comment: Schema 1.31 adds the optional node group color (an 8-bit sRGB triple after padding; absent means the neutral frame). Schema 1.30 adds Blender's keyframe easing equations: the interpolation tokens sine, quad, cubic, quart, quint, expo, circ, back, bounce and elastic, and the optional keyframe member easing (mode, back, amplitude, period). It also adds the optional presentation-only layer members shy and nameFollowsSource. The document shape is otherwise 1.29's.

nodeGroup-1.31.$comment: A node group frames member cards. It is layout only: no ports, no encapsulation, no evaluation meaning. Document 1.31 adds the optional frame color.

nodeGroup-1.2.$comment: A node group frames member cards. It is layout only: no ports, no encapsulation, no evaluation meaning.

humanFacingName.$comment: The normative 4096-byte UTF-8 ceiling is enforced by Project I/O; JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode scalars.

structuralText.$comment: The normative 256-byte UTF-8 ceiling is enforced by Project I/O; JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode scalars.

path.$comment: The 4096-byte UTF-8 ceiling and complete normalized-component profile are Project I/O checks.

externalFileUri.$comment: Project I/O enforces the exact RFC 8089 subset, percent-escape rules, and decoded .ocioz/config.ocio leaf name.

value.$comment: The normative 4096-byte UTF-8 ceiling is enforced by Project I/O.

parameterValue-1.4.$comment: 1.4 adds the vec3 constant kind, the third authoring vector width. Its own kind token rather than a third component on vec2, because the discriminators name TYPES and a three-component vector is a different type -- so an older minor refuses it outright instead of reading it as a vec2 with a stray member. Every other arm is exactly parameterValue-1.0's, which is left as it shipped.

color4Keyframe-1.3.$comment: 1.3 adds the color4 animation-curve kind and the ease-in-out interpolation token; the historical animationCurve-1.0/scalarKeyframe-1.0/vec2Keyframe-1.0 definitions are left exactly as they shipped in their own artifacts. A straight/unassociated authoring RGBA key. Channel order is the authoring order the constant color4 parameter value already writes, and alpha is confined to the unit interval exactly as a constant authoring color is.

keyframeInterpolation-1.3.$comment: ease-in-out is a cubic Bezier ease with fixed symmetric handles; see animation-and-time.md.

highestIssued-1.2.$comment: The ten document 1.0 namespaces plus nodeGroup, which document 1.2 adds. Members beyond these remain unknown singleton data and never enter IdAllocatorHighWater.

highestIssued-1.0.$comment: Only these ten members have v1 allocator meaning. Additive members remain unknown singleton data and never enter IdAllocatorHighWater.

canonicalBase64.$comment: Project I/O rejects nonzero unused tail bits and checks the decoded per-record and aggregate payload ceilings before allocation.

keyframeInterpolation-1.30.$comment: ease-in-out is the handle-driven cubic Bezier; the ten easing equations are Blender's (Robert Penner's) and read the left key's easing member. See animation-and-time.md.

keyframeEasing-1.30.$comment: Omitted when default: mode auto, back 1.70158, amplitude 0.8, period 4.1/24 seconds. A period of zero is the automatic period.

highestIssued-1.24.$comment: The ten document 1.0 namespaces plus nodeGroup, which document 1.2 adds. Members beyond these remain unknown singleton data and never enter IdAllocatorHighWater. Document 1.24 adds the optional layerMask.

exportRange-1.29.$comment: last is written only for the custom kind; Project I/O refuses it otherwise.
